scope: Paired source-observed dynamic appearance; learned/estimated source poses retained, no held-out or independent 3D motion truth
canvas: same full-resolution source camera at each actual exposure
roi: union of all reviewed real reference masks; same 1.10 square expansion and 512px crop as static core; fixed for every frame/method
compositing: reference uses its visible mask; prediction uses own alpha and white compositing only; no reference mask applied to predictions
time: all strictly increasing real exposure timestamps; adjacent displacement at actual shared intervals, no interpolation/looping/retiming
aggregation: equal real frames for appearance; equal actual adjacent frame pairs for temporal metrics; each identity then equally weighted on a common identity/pair set
tOF: mean adjacent pairs mean all ROI pixels sqrt((Fx_ref-Fx_pred)^2+(Fy_ref-Fy_pred)^2)
tOF_unit: pixels per observed frame interval on fixed 512x512 ROI
tLP100: 100 * mean adjacent pairs abs(LPIPS(ref_previous,ref_current)-LPIPS(pred_previous,pred_current)); frozen AlexNet v0.1
deviations_from_tecogan: Full common ROI and all real exposure pairs, no original crop_8x8 or two-frame boundary removal; pinned current AlexNet v0.1, not original bundled LPIPS. Do not compare numbers directly to TecoGAN tables.
missing: technical failure is NA with reason, no synthetic white image; report real frame/pair counts and n/100
limitations: Image-estimated flow includes mask boundaries and camera motion; not ground-truth 3D motion.
Temporal similarity alone does not imply correct actions or appearance; always report per-frame quality.
Reference segmentation and small carried objects are blurred pixel annotations, not subpixel truth.
One-person pilot cannot establish dataset-level ranking.
